capabilities: Run multiple reviews per day and resume unfinished reviews
Attach expectation descriptions to card sides
Schedule cards by level so known cards appear less often
Create flashcards via a helper command or manually with frontmatter
Feed new cards into reviews gradually
extras: Docs reference screenshots hosted elsewhere and include a Buy Me A Coffee donation link.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to review flashcards, and typical flashcard tools lock reviews to fixed time intervals and leave unclear what a card's answer should be.
summary: Flashcard system that schedules card reviews by level-based repetition rather than fixed time intervals.
